json_a.modelDescription: System-centric decomposition of an automobile. Top-level entities represent major vehicle systems (engine, drivetrain, electrical, etc.), with subsystems and components composed within them.

json_b.modelDescription: Component-centric decomposition of an automobile. Entities represent individual physical components with minimal nesting. Relationships between components are primarily expressed through Associations rather than composition, creating a flatter, more interconnected model.

path_steps.definition: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
a conveyance that transports people or objects
